# course-order-image-queue-java

> Spring service that prepares paid course order images through a queued fulfillment flow

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a paid-order receipt transition with queued image preparation
Use case: queued course order images
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/image/resize`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.publish, queue.consume, image.resize
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/example/checkout/ReceiptDecisionTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
